facts.text: I recently finished "The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo".
I was part of an online book club discussion on Facebook Live on February 22nd.
The author responded to my question during the February 22nd Facebook Live discussion.
I have been meaning to read "The Royal We" for a while.
I heard Emily St. John Mandel read from "Sea of Tranquility" at my local library.
I was impressed by Emily St. John Mandel's writing style.
I asked Emily St. John Mandel a question.
I bought a signed copy of the book afterwards.
I asked Emily St. John Mandel about her inspiration for the character of Olive Llewellyn.
I attended a literary festival on March 4th.
At the March 4th literary festival, I saw authors Celeste Ng, Tommy Orange, and Ayobami Adebayo discuss diversity in contemporary literature.
I discussed the theme of power dynamics and resistance in my work book club last month.
My work book club last month read "The Power" by Naomi Alderman.
I loved "The Power" by Naomi Alderman.
Our book club discussion of "The Power" was fascinating.
Our book club discussion had a discussion leader named Rachel.
